problem: A direct concept question was treated as an overheard utterance. One model call ended in private clarification prose, with no tools or delivered help.
change: Separate direct-request task adapter, explicit checkpointed response delivery, optional tool use, bounded empty-output continuation, and a readable supplied-document ID/title catalog.
comparison_conditions: Same configured local Qwen2.5 14B model and budgets. Task prompt, delivery contract and tool set differ from the frozen conversation baseline. v1/v2 also differ in source catalog and prompt context. These are development repair checks, not an isolated ablation or held-out benchmark.

checks.name: Lab HTTP, input, mode isolation and output projection
Direct runtime: delivery, budgets, checkpoint replay and source catalog
All selected workers and frozen-source integrity

result: v2 delivers all five responses. The reported concept no longer produces clarification-only output, but remains only a partial match to the intended modern LLM-harness explanation. The source question now reads and uses the provided document. No exact deadline is fabricated.
limitations: Two concept repetitions are not independent scenarios.
Concept precision remains limited; no general quality improvement claim.
The supplied-source v2 run still repeats one read.
Missing-information output mentions file paths although the UI accepts pasted source text, not local file access.
No live web, real ASR, persistent chat or automatic semantic grading.
Original four replay configurations remain unchanged in task semantics and are not comparable QA baselines.
The old service could not be restarted because automatic approval review rejected stopping it. The repaired service and website link use localhost:8769.
